reviewerDisposition.rootCauseAnalysis: CAP-03.S04.T03-R01-F02 persisted through R02 because the remediation treated a canonical pending-to-runnable snapshot transition as if it also created the executor's mutable queue projection. The test asserted only snapshot/Task Center step state after restart and never attempted a real queue claim, so it mirrored the incomplete implementation. R03 makes immutable authority and mutable job admission one transaction and extends the acceptance proof through Task Center projection, restart claim, exact replay, and injected rollback.
